verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web/UI framework (CLI, components, rendering, routing). It does not hold or analyze end-user data, so in-product AI-generated insights about a user's data is a category error for this kind of product. Its agent-facing features (AGENTS.md, llms-full.txt, Markdown docs) help coding agents write code and do not generate data insights, and its server-rendered SVG charts are not AI-driven.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
